card.name: The D in 5% Dextrose
card.fires_on: The split-off letter D (or d) of 'Dextrose' right after '5%' in IV diluent lists, where the rest of the word 'extrose' follows.

modes.label: 5% D-extrose diluent
modes.description: The first piece of 'Dextrose' after 5% in lists of compatible IV fluids.
modes.example: IV Solution 5%<< D>>extrose in Normal Saline 1
